Game Overview

In Big Shark, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the depths as a ravenous shark in Big Shark, where intuitive tap-to-move controls guide you through a vibrant underwater world. Consume smaller fish to grow while dodging larger threats in a thrilling journey of survival and discovery. Can you become the ocean's top predator?
